extName.description: The extension's name, shown in the browser toolbar and extensions management page.

extDescription.message: Blocks ads and trackers, and silently closes popup/redirect tabs, without nag screens.
extDescription.description: The extension's short description, shown on the extensions management page and store listing.

popupOnboardingCard.message: Moat blocks ads and trackers automatically. Use the switch below to pause it on a site, or Settings to fine-tune.

popupProtectionNone.message: Nothing to block on this page

popupPausedSuffix.message: . Reload the page to see it unblocked.

popupLoadError.message: Couldn't load status. Try reopening the popup.

optionsTagline.message: Blocks ads, trackers, and hijacked popups.

optionsMasterToggleHint.message: Turn all blocking on or off, everywhere.

optionsCookiesToggleHint.message: Stops sites from tracking you as you move from one to the next.

optionsWebrtcToggleHint.message: Stops a page from reading your real IP address behind a VPN.

optionsFingerprintToggleHint.message: Adds a little noise to the device details sites use to identify you. Can occasionally interfere with a CAPTCHA.

optionsFingerprintRotateToggleHint.message: Regenerates the noise every time the browser restarts, so it can't settle into a fixed identifier of its own. Sites see a slightly different device each session.

optionsGrayscaleToggleHint.message: Fades in-stream video ads, like YouTube's, to grayscale while they play.

optionsFeedScanToggleHint.message: Removes sponsored and promoted posts from Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube as you scroll.

optionsConsentRejectToggleHint.message: Clicks “reject” or “decline” on common consent banners for you.

optionsCnameToggleHint.message: Blocks trackers that hide behind a subdomain of the site you're on.

optionsLiveListHint.message: Refreshes the popup and redirect blocklist from GitHub once a day.

optionsExceptionsHint.message: Moat is turned off completely on these sites.

optionsFilterBudgetWarning.message: Some filter lists aren't fully active. Browsers cap how many blocking rules all extensions can share, and that cap is often reached when several ad blockers or privacy extensions run together -- disable another one, or turn a list off below.

optionsFilterBudgetDetail.message: Your browser reports $COUNT$ shared rule slots left across all extensions. If that stays low after disabling other extensions and reloading Moat, turn a list off below -- Annoyances or Cookie Notices first.

optionsFilterBudgetDropped.message: Turned off for now so the rest of your lists stay within the browser's shared rule limit: $NAMES$.

optionsIndividualListsHint.message: Turn lists on or off individually. Any change sets the level to Custom.

optionsBlockedSitesHint.message: Always block these sites, whatever the filter lists say.

optionsAllowedSitesHint.message: Never block these sites, even when a filter list matches.

optionsHiddenElementsHint.message: Elements you hid with the “Block an element” tool. Remove one to bring it back.

optionsDimmedElementsHint.message: Elements you grayed out with the picker. Remove one to restore it.

optionsTrackersEmpty.message: No trackers attributed on the tab you last had open.

optionsTrackersUnsupported.message: Per-request attribution is Chrome-only -- Firefox doesn't expose the needed API yet.

optionsPrivacyIntro.message: Everything on this page is stored locally in your browser and never sent to Moat's developer. The privacy policy covers the few opt-in features -- breach checking and settings sync -- that contact anyone else.

optionsBackupIntro.message: Save your settings to a file, or load one back in. The fingerprint-resistance identifier is never included.

optionsSyncToggleHint.message: Mirrors your settings through your browser's own sync account. A new install picks them up once; it doesn't merge edits made on two devices at the same time.

optionsSyncStatusFailed.message: Couldn't sync your settings ($WHEN$) -- they may be over your browser's sync-storage limit (custom rules and site lists count toward it). They're still saved locally.

presetHintLite.message: Like Essential, without the largest security list.

presetHintStrict.message: Every list, plus the privacy toggles above.

presetHintCustom.message: A mix you've set up yourself.

optionsLiveStatusFailed.message: Last attempt failed ($WHEN$) — using the bundled baseline until the next try.

optionsImportedInvalid.message: That file doesn't look like a valid Moat settings export.

leakedPasswordWarning.message: This password has appeared in a known data breach.

optionsLeakedPasswordToggleHint.message: Warns if a password you type has appeared in a known breach. Only a short piece of its hash ever leaves your device.
